text:
morgan: FYI acmeretail just escalated — seeing 99th pct tail latency spikes on dedicated pool during qps bursts. CS posted logs. Need owners + quick mitigation plan. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2345
julia-cs: confirming — spikes started around 11:10 UTC. Customers report timeouts on heavy billing endpoints. I can share sample traces in the ticket.
devon: looking. initial hunch: autoscaler didn't add nodes fast enough; queue depth hit limit. Oncall, can you confirm?
sasha: I saw pod CPU at 95% and NVMe IO jumps. Could be batcher backpressure. If we switch routing for this customer to hosted fallback that's available, we can remove pressure.
lee: We can push a routing override to route acmeretail -> hosted model v2-rls for bursts. That's ~2-3min change. Need approval to escalate to hosted fallback (billing impacts).
anita: I can own the routing change and monitor. Will need eng-sre to temporarily bump pool capacity / allow burst capacity for 30m.
oncall-bot: Incident created INF-2345. Alerts paged to eng-sre. Current severity: P1. runbook: /runbooks/dedicated-latency
devon: eng-sre (lee?) can you check autoscaler logs and increase target if safe? If autoscaler can't catch up, we'll route traffic.
lee: eng-sre is oncall today (sam). @sam can you confirm capacity bump? If not, I'll do routing override.
sam: Oncall here — autoscaler didn't scale past 6 nodes due to quota. Requesting quota increase in cloud console will take ~30-45m. I can manually provision 1 extra node now as temporary.
anita: ok manual node + routing fallback. I will open the routing PR and hold change until sam confirms node up. Plan: 1) sam spins up node (now) 2) anita applies routing override for acmeretail to hosted for burst (after node live if still needed) 3) monitor traces and revert within 1h. Owners: anita (routing), sam (sre), devon (root cause).
julia-cs: :+1: I’ll tell the customer we have an immediate workaround and ETA ~1h for mitigation.
devon: I'll triage logs and see if batcher config or kernel selection caused the IO spike. If it's batcher bug, we'll schedule hotfix — 24-48h.
release-bot: Canary release window open in 20m. If we need a hotfix patch, request a patch branch and canary then promote.
morgan: Thanks. Action items summarized: anita route override (if needed), sam manual node, devon investigate root cause, julia CS customer comms. I'll update INF-2345 with timeline. Ping here when node is up or routing applied. :eyes: 
sam: Manual node provisioned at 1968765460. I'll monitor autoscaler logs.
anita: Starting routing PR now, will only apply if after 10m we still see timeouts.
devon: Saw two correlated errors in traces: kv-cache miss storms during long sequences — investigating quantization fallbacks. If kv-cache thrash, caching tweak may be safer than routing long-term.
morgan: Good. We'll keep temporary routing to buy time. Follow-up: devon to propose config change by EOD; eng-platform to schedule postmortem if bug confirmed.
julia-cs: Customer update sent: 'We are applying an immediate mitigation and expect service improvement within the hour. We'll follow up with root cause and timeline.'
anita: Applied routing override at 1968765580 — rolling applied, monitoring.
sam: Seeing decreased queue depth, timeouts down. Will leave manual node for 1h and then coordinate scale-down.
morgan: Closing loop: INF-2345 updated with owners and times. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
